title: GPU spiral digest - cluster & pool daily rollup
content:
Purpose
A compact daily digest intended for the infra oncall and capacity owners showing a small set of spiral metrics that help detect slowly accreting headroom loss across clusters and pools. This is not the full heatmap export - think of it as a shortwatch to surface persistent drift vs single-day spikes.

Scope
- Fleet snapshot for 2026-07-15 00:00 - 2026-07-15 23:59 UTC
- Regions: na, eu, apac (primary clusters only)
- Granularity: per-cluster and per-pool daily rollup, plus 7-day rolling median and skew indicator

Highlights (quick take)
- Fleet mean utilization: 61% (7-day median 59%) => +2ppt drift over 7d
- 4 clusters show sustained tail growth in burst jobs (see cluster table)
- Pool 'interactive-highprio' in na-west1 exceeded 85% at 95th percentile for slot occupancy during 14:00-17:00 UTC window -> potential risk to SLO if trend continues
- Autoscaler churn on eu-central1 pool-3 increased errors by 1.6x during microburst spikes

Key metrics snapshot (top 10 by utilization drift)
Cluster/Pool            | Region | Util 24h | 7d median | Drift ppt | 95th slot occ | Notes
------------------------|--------|----------|-----------|----------:|---------------|---------------------------
cluster-alpha-poolA     | na     | 78%      | 65%       |      13   | 0.91          | bursty training jobs, long tails
cluster-gamma-pool4     | eu     | 72%      | 69%       |       3   | 0.74          | steady, watch queuing
cluster-delta-poolX     | apac   | 68%      | 55%       |      13   | 0.85          | migration of ci jobs this week
cluster-beta-interactive | na     | 86%      | 82%       |       4   | 0.95          | highprio interactive hits 85% SLO
cluster-omega-pool7     | eu     | 51%      | 60%       |      -9   | 0.52          | recently drained for maintenance

Methodology notes
- Util 24h is average vCPU-equivalent utilization across all GPUs in the pool for the window
- 7d median uses 7-day rolling median of daily utilizations to reduce noise from single-day spikes
- Drift ppt = util 24h minus 7d median (percentage points) to highlight accretion
- 95th slot occupancy is computed over 5-minute samples and represents the upper tail of concurrent slot usage
- Data sources: telemetry export v3 -> transform script fleet-spiral-agg v0.6 -> this digest

Anomaly markers and rationale
- Marker A: sustained positive drift > 10ppt and 95th slot occ > 0.8 flagged as 'rising congestion' (applied to alpha and delta above)
- Marker B: negative drift < -8ppt and util < 55% is 'draining/idle', candidate for consolidation (omega)
- Marker C: High autoscaler churn threshold > 1.5x baseline triggers further SRE triage (eu pool-3)

Quick correlation checks performed
- Cross-referenced job tags for top-drift clusters: found repeated job set 'nightly-eval-heavy' in cluster-alpha contributing ~22% of GPU-hours during the spike window
- Network egress/ingest not a correlated factor for alpha/delta on sampling

Recommended immediate actions (next 72h)
- For cluster-alpha-poolA: temporarily shift nightly-eval-heavy to beta-interactive-spot via scheduling rule JIRA-OPS-1427 until new reserved capacity comes online
- For cluster-beta-interactive: add a short-term canary quota cap (10% of pool) for 'interactive-highprio' to protect SLOs during afternoon windows
- For eu pool-3: attach detailed autoscaler logs to GH PR 279 and run a 6-hour simulated microburst replay in staging

Longer term suggestions
- Add a 'drift monitor' alert that fires when drift > 8ppt for 3 consecutive days, with a severity that pages on the 4th day
- Expand 95th slot occupancy telemetry retention to 30 days for easier rolling trend analysis
- Consider bin-packing consolidation for pools with repeated negative drift to reduce idle slices

Open questions / TODOs
- Who owns the nightly-eval-heavy jobset? initial owner guess: ml-evals team, tagging incomplete - Priya to confirm
- Validate whether we can apply preemption friendly spot instances to alpha without service impact
- Confirm whether reserved capacity purchase for na-west1 is on roadmap for Q3 (product finance)

Appendix: brief raw numbers used for table generation
- total gpu nodes sampled: 3,412
- total gpu slots: 18,960
- fleet average gpu util (24h): 61%
- fleet 7d median: 59%

Contacts and meeting
- I will present this digest weekly in infra standup; propose 10 minutes on Monday to review any active flags
- Owners: Maya Chen (author), Jamal Rivera (ops), Priya Nair (capacity)
